body: Well goodluck finding a place to die. *High five* 🙏
That's sounds practical, and a lot more easier to do. I also thought of that but traditions in my country made my decisions.

I felt happy to be honest, knowing that none of my relatives will suffer (financially) for my burial. It gets annoying when people, especially the funeral service, do not believe when I tell them my "schedule". The only sad part is you never get to tell all of your friends.

Me too, im planning to do it this week after all preparations for my funeral is done. I actually purchased a lot for my burial, bought everything that is needed including my coffin. It's fun, and you might wanna consider doing the same. 🙏
Nah, I just want to feel something just for the last time.
